summary: UI evidence (ProjectUITests testProjectDiffPillOpensGitDiffPane) triggers the global App-menu 'Pending Changes' command (openRightPane(.review) via PiNativeApp.swift CommandGroup), not the actual project-specific control ('Show Pending Changes' context-menu row action -> showPendingChanges(projectID:) in ProjectSidebarView.swift); the unit test that does exercise the real project-specific control (testShowPendingChangesOpensProjectReviewWithoutChangingSelectedConversation) only asserts navigation state (isRightPaneOpen/rightPaneMode/reviewProjectID) and never asserts that the Git status summary is displayed, so no test verifies the requirement's actual conjunction of project-specific-control + displayed summary together.
